description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6150015079159 CABLE ASSEMBLY,SPEC: Line 0001 Qty 11 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0112 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
